  Whole-page layouts assembled from components, ready to copy.
cards_heading: Page templates
---

A template is a complete page structure — header, breadcrumbs, content region,
footer — that you copy and fill in. Templates fix the decisions that should be
the same on every page so you can spend your effort on the content.

Every template in this section assumes the QGDS stylesheet and module are
already loaded. See [Developing]({{ '/get-started/developing.html' | relative_url }}).
